title: Unlawful Search and Seizure by Director General or Officer

content.scenario: The Director General of the Consumer Protection Authority, without reasonable grounds, searches the premises of a small business in Mumbai and seizes several documents. The business owner claims that the search and seizure were unlawful and demands action against the Director General.
content.outcome: The Director General may be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with a fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both, as per Section 93 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the punishment for unlawful search and seizure by the Director General?
Can the Director General be held liable for unlawful search and seizure?
What are the consequences of violating Section 93 of the Consumer Protection Act?
